task_title: Floor 1 dungeon walls: square corners and flush door junctions

plan_review.notes: 0 blocking, 3 non-blocking. (1) Corner style lived in an opt-IN pack-id set that a future floor3-dungeon could silently miss - resolved by making the registry EXHAUSTIVE over all shipped packs plus a fail-to-pass test asserting every public/assets/terrain-packs dir is declared; rejected the reviewers preferred manifest-owned field because cornerStyle is build-time-only data and composePack would still need an authoring-side registry to generate the manifest. (2) terrain-pack-lab computed masks with doors as non-walls - resolved by exporting PACK_WALL_MASK_NEIGHBOR_TERRAIN_TYPES from terrain-renderer and importing it into the lab neighbour predicate only. (3) door regression test only covered industrial-cave - resolved by it.each over floor1-dungeon and industrial-cave. Reviewer independently confirmed geometry/byte-stability math (48/256 source bite = 12 output px, corner sample 6 px, edge band starts at 16 px) and that DOOR is the only punched-hole TerrainType.

rounds.notes: Reviewed the full diff (quadrant-kit corner-style parameterization, png-buffer eraseRect, compose-pack threading, validate.ts style derivation, terrain-renderer DOOR mask rule, regenerated floor1-dungeon atlas, tests). No issues found.

Covered the post-round-1 edits (exhaustive registry, lab wiring, parameterized door test). TWO real findings, both fixed. (1) BLOCKER: npm run terrain-packs:validate failed with 40 cross-pack-silhouette-mismatch errors because floor1.manifest.json makes floor1-dungeon and floor1-cave co-resident and validateCrossPackWallSilhouettes demanded byte-identical silhouettes. Measured the conflict: 2214 differing pixels across 47 masks, 0 on the outermost boundary ring, 0 in the cardinal edge bands - all strictly interior. Escalated the design question to the human, who chose boundary-ring compatibility; implemented in validate.ts with a compareInterior flag and a new cross-pack-seam-mismatch code, documented in ADR 0078, and pinned by 4 new regression tests (real pair passes, boundary-ring flip still fails, interior flip tolerated for mixed styles, same-style pair still fails on interior flip). (2) Prototype-chain pack ids (constructor, toString, __proto__) returned an inherited truthy value from the plain-object corner-style registry, so the ?? DEFAULT fallback never fired and a non-WallCornerStyle reached the geometry branch; ComposePackInput.id is an arbitrary string. Fixed by switching the registry to a ReadonlyMap plus a prototype-key regression test.
